'''Thomas A.C. Reydon''' (born 1969) is a Dutch philosopher and professor of philosophy of science and technology at [[Leibniz University of Hannover]]. He is known for his works on [[philosophy of science]].<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Maienschein |first1=Jane |title=Review of Vitalism and the Scientific Image in Post-Enlightenment Life Science, 1800-2010 |journal=NDPR |date=30 October 2013 |url=https://ndpr.nd.edu/reviews/vitalism-and-the-scientific-image-in-post-enlightenment-life-science-1800-2010/ |language=en |issn=1538-1617}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Thomas A.C. Reydon |url=https://sciprofiles.com/profile/3348374 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240415214932/https://sciprofiles.com/profile/3348374 |archive-date=2024-04-15 |access-date=2026-02-22 |website=sciprofiles.com}}</ref> He is an editor-in-chief of the ''[[Journal for General Philosophy of Science]]''<ref>{{Cite web |title=Journal for General Philosophy of Science |url=https://link.springer.com/journal/10838/editorial-board |access-date=2026-02-22 |website=SpringerLink |language=en}}</ref> and an elected Fellow of the [[Linnean Society of London]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Thomas Reydon |url=https://www.fis.uni-hannover.de/portal/en/researchers/thomas-reydon(e090fc8e-a61a-4e60-98f9-c5b83030678e).html |access-date=2026-02-23 |website=[[Leibniz University]] |language=en}}</ref>

==Books==
* ''The Scope of Evolutionary Thinking'', Cambridge University Press, 2025 (Cambridge Elements in the Philosophy of Biology) 
* ''Wissenschaftsethik: Eine Einführung'', Ulmer/UTB, 2013 
* ''Cultural Evolution and Social Ontology: Interdisciplinary Perspectives'', Edited with Martina Valković, Routledge, 2026 (Routledge Studies in Contemporary Philosophy) 
* ''Evolutionary Thinking Across Disciplines: Problems and Perspectives in Generalized Darwinism'', Edited with Agathe Du Crest, Martina Valković, André Ariew, Hugh Desmond and Philippe Huneman Springer, 2023 (Synthese Library Vol. 478) 
* ''Grundriss Wissenschaftsphilosophie:Die Philosophien der Einzelwissenschaften'', Edited with Simon Lohse, Felix Meiner Verlag, 2017; licensed edition: Wissenschaftliche Buchgesellschaft, 2017<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Stöckler |first=Manfred |date=September 2018 |title=Simon Lohse and Thomas Reydon (Eds.): Grundriss Wissenschaftsphilosophie. Die Philosophien der Einzelwissenschaften: Meiner, Hamburg, 2017, 658 pp, €78.00, {{text|ISBN}}: 9783787329861 |url=http://link.springer.com/10.1007/s10838-018-9417-0 |journal=Journal for General Philosophy of Science |language=en |volume=49 |issue=3 |pages=495–497 |doi=10.1007/s10838-018-9417-0 |issn=0925-4560|url-access=subscription }}</ref>
* ''Artefact Kinds: Ontology and the Human-Made World'', Edited with Maarten Franssen, Peter Kroes and Pieter Vermaas, Springer, 2014 (Synthese Library Vol. 365) 
* ''Philosophy of Behavioral Biology'', Edited with Kathryn Plaisance, Springer, 2012 (Boston Studies in the Philosophy of Science Vol. 282)<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Trestman |first=Michael |date=July 2013 |title=Explaining behavior: Kathryn S. Plaisance and Thomas A. C. Reydon (eds): Philosophy of behavioral biology. Boston Studies in the Philosophy and History of Science, vol. 282. Dordrecht: Springer, 2012, viii+373pp, €139.95, $189.00 HB |url=http://link.springer.com/10.1007/s11016-012-9732-8 |journal=Metascience |language=en |volume=22 |issue=2 |pages=375–378 |doi=10.1007/s11016-012-9732-8 |issn=0815-0796|url-access=subscription }}</ref>
* ''Der universale Leibniz: Denker, Forscher, Erfinder'', Edited with Helmut Heit and Paul Hoyningen-Huene, Franz Steiner Verlag, 2009 
*''Current Themes in Theoretical Biology: A Dutch Perspective'', Edited with Lia Hemerik, Springer, 2005
